findings.summary: On QR failure, the code changes the image to a status role while inserting its message, so assistive technology may not announce the failure reliably.
findings.fix: Add an initially empty, persistent status element in the template and update its text on failure; keep the QR image separate rather than changing its role.

notes: After review, QR error output was moved to a persistent status live region and the QR image role remains unchanged. This fix was verified directly in source.
